preflight_l11_ijr.formula: gross_alpha = 0.40 × IC × sqrt(N) × sigma_target; gate_ratio = gross_alpha / (cost_frac × N)
preflight_l11_ijr.IC_justification: Conservative estimate for intraday FX signal per CLAUDE.md methodology (daily futures IC>0.04). Pre-registered in hypothesis.md. Cannot be changed without consuming 1 modification budget and re-committing hypothesis.md.
preflight_l11_ijr.N_estimation_method: Analytical (pre-download): 252 × F4(0.60) × F1(0.57) × F3(0.75) × F2+F5(0.90) ≈ 58/pair/yr. N_trades = 4×58 = 232 (independent pairs). N_calendar ≈ 94 (GBP-correlated treatment: 2 independent groups, P(≥1 fires) ≈ 0.622).

at_N_trades.N_description: Total annual trades across basket (all pairs treated as independent)

at_N_calendar.N_description: Calendar days with ≥1 pair signal (portfolio breadth, most favorable to IJR)

structural_analysis.formula_simplified: gate_ratio = C / sqrt(N)  where  C = 0.40 × IC × sigma / mean_cost_frac
structural_analysis.interpretation: gate_ratio DECREASES with N. At IC=0.05, gate passes only at N ≤ 5.88 trades/yr. Structurally impossible for any realistic intraday FX strategy. IJR formula designed for symmetric CS equity strategies (N≥30 instruments, low per-trade IC); it conflates breadth with portfolio turnover in ways that systematically understate gross alpha for TP/SL breakout strategies with small universes.

preflight_l11_breakout_alt.status: INFORMATIONAL — ad-hoc formula, no academic citation. CANNOT replace IJR gate per pre-registration rules.
preflight_l11_breakout_alt.formula: E[gross/trade] = win_rate × (TP_mult/SL_mult × eq_risk) − (1−win_rate) × eq_risk; gate_ratio = gross/trade ÷ mean_cost_frac  [N-independent]
preflight_l11_breakout_alt.rationale: Direct binary trade P&L economics for TP/SL strategy. Unlike IJR, gate_ratio is independent of N because both gross and cost scale linearly with N (they cancel). More natural for asymmetric-outcome strategies with fixed R:R. Presented as informational only — not a registered gate substitute.
preflight_l11_breakout_alt.interpretation: At IC=0.05: gate_ratio=2.565 < 3.0 → FAIL even on ad-hoc model. Alt gate passes at IC≥0.107 (win_rate≥0.553). London-open breakout in Tzimopoulos (2025) sweet-spot conditions suggests 55-60% win rates are plausible (IC≈0.10-0.20). IF user recalibrates IC in hypothesis.md with documented justification (consumes 1 mod), alt gate would pass at IC≥0.107. NOT a gate substitute per pre-registration.
preflight_l11_breakout_alt.note: Both gates (IJR binding, alt informational) fail at IC=0.05. Paths forward: (A) ARCHIVE F2 — strict pre-registration adherence; (B) REVISE GATE to direct trade P&L model (1 mod budget) with IC recalibrated from Tzimopoulos 2025 win-rate data; (C) REVISE IC only keeping IJR formula (1 mod) — requires IC≥0.200 to pass IJR at N_calendar=94, not credibly supported by any intraday FX literature. Path B is methodologically cleaner if user believes in the strategy.
